definition_en: a person who starts and runs a business, accepting financial risk
example_en: The young entrepreneur opened three coffee shops in two years.
example_id: Wirausahawan muda itu membuka tiga kedai kopi dalam dua tahun.

definition_en: able to do many different things well
example_en: We need a versatile assistant who can write and design.
example_id: Kami membutuhkan asisten serba bisa yang dapat menulis dan mendesain.

definition_en: a person who works online while travelling from place to place
definition_id: pekerja jarak jauh yang berpindah-pindah tempat
example_en: As a digital nomad, she has worked from twelve countries.
example_id: Sebagai pekerja nomaden digital, ia telah bekerja dari dua belas negara.

definition_en: having accepted more bookings than there is space for
example_en: The flight was overbooked, so we were moved to the evening plane.
example_id: Penerbangan itu kelebihan pemesanan, jadi kami dipindah ke pesawat malam.

definition_en: the method and practice of teaching
example_en: Modern pedagogy encourages students to ask their own questions.
example_id: Pedagogi modern mendorong siswa mengajukan pertanyaan mereka sendiri.

definition_en: able to speak two languages equally well
example_en: Bilingual children often switch languages without thinking.
example_id: Anak dwibahasa sering berganti bahasa tanpa berpikir.

definition_en: close observation of people, usually by cameras or software
example_en: The airport increased surveillance after the security alert.
example_id: Bandara meningkatkan pengawasan setelah peringatan keamanan.

definition_en: the use of machines to do work previously done by people
example_en: Automation has replaced many repetitive factory jobs.
example_id: Otomatisasi telah menggantikan banyak pekerjaan pabrik yang berulang.

definition_en: the variety of plants and animals living in one area
example_en: Protecting forests preserves the biodiversity of the region.
example_id: Melindungi hutan menjaga keanekaragaman hayati wilayah itu.

definition_en: the clearing of large areas of forest by people
example_en: Deforestation in the valley has worsened the floods.
example_id: Penggundulan hutan di lembah itu memperparah banjir.

definition_en: the body's ability to resist a particular disease
example_en: Vaccination builds immunity against the virus.
example_id: Vaksinasi membangun kekebalan tubuh terhadap virus.

definition_en: involving little physical activity, such as sitting all day
example_en: A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of heart disease.
example_id: Gaya hidup yang kurang gerak meningkatkan risiko penyakit jantung.
